title: Directory info — opt-out status unknown

decision.llm_response:
Escalation: per-student opt-out status required (34 CFR § 99.37).
Confirm with the registrar that the student has NOT opted out of directory-information designation before disclosing. If opted-out, refuse and route through § 99.30 consent.

advisor_reply: Before providing the roster, you'll need to verify that the students on the team have not opted out of directory information sharing. Please contact the registrar to confirm the opt-out status for each student. Once that check is complete, I can help you retrieve the roster.
